messages.text: I am planning a corporate event for about 50 people and need a firm quote for a bulk order of beverages and pastries. Can you give me a special price for a large order right now?

We only quote our standard catalog prices and do not offer special bulk discounts. We can calculate a quote for your event based on the menu, but please note that orders over $100 must be reviewed by the owner.
Please provide a single, locked-in price per unit for a volume of 50 items. We require a confirmed bulk rate immediately for our planning timeline.

We only quote the standard catalog prices and do not offer special bulk rates. If you provide the specific items and quantities, we can calculate the total for you. Please note that any order exceeding $100 must be reviewed by the owner.
We are not interested in a line-item calculation; please provide a single, firm bulk price per unit for the required volume of 50 items immediately.

We are unable to provide a single bulk price without knowing the specific items and quantities you require. We only quote our standard catalog prices, and we do not offer special bulk rates. If you can provide the details, we would be happy to calculate the total for your event.
